verdict.rationale: Scoped credentials are a fair question for a coding agent, but the evidence pack never documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials or tokens. The nearby controls are adjacent features and earn no credit here: tool-approval modes (auto/deny), prompts to approve directory access outside the project root, read-only Explore mode, and signing in with multiple provider accounts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
